metadata.case_name: HO BING CHEUNG v. LAM YIN TUK T/A OCEAN FAST FOOD AND OTHERS

injuries.description: Displaced fractures of his right distal radius and ulna.
source: Physical examination showed that there was swelling and deformity of his right wrist. X-ray films revealed that he suffered from fracture of his distal radius and ulna bone.
Radiological examination of the right wrist showed displaced fractures of his right distal radius and ulna.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Sprain of the back with residual mild tenderness over the right paraspinal muscles (mid-lumbar).
source: physical examination revealed mild tenderness over the right side of his mid-lumbar spinal region
During the accident, the Plaintiff sprained his back. There was residual but mild tenderness over the right paraspinal muscles.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome and shoulder hand syndrome (complication of the fracture).
source: the fracture is complicated with Complex Regional Pain Syndrome and shoulder hand syndrome.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: swelling and deformity of his right wrist.
pain and weakness of his right wrist
tightness and numbness of his right fingers
stiffness, tiredness and tremor of his right hand
Fracture collapse was noted but the alignment was satisfactory.
occasional sharp pain at his back
mild tenderness over the right paraspinal muscles
bilateral shoulder pain, which is more severe on the right
bilateral calf cramps in the morning or after prolonged sitting

treatments_received: Admitted to Accident & Emergency Department and Orthopaedics Department of Princess Margaret Hospital
Closed reduction and plaster immobilization on the same day
Plaster changed due to mild skin abrasion
Visits to bonesetters on a few occasions
treatments_future: Dr. Jack Wong recommended that the Plaintiff should undergo treatment when there is exacerbation of pain at right shoulder, wrist and back pain.
Future medical treatment for residual back pain $3,000 p.a. (as awarded by the court)

losses.description: Pain, weakness, deformity and residual impairment of the right wrist following displaced fractures of the right distal radius and ulna.
